# makeGroupsToFlatten groups set operations by their recursive member sets.
builder
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
prim b bool
union u1 i,s n=U1
union u2 u1,s n=U2
uunion u3 n=U3
members u3 i
union u4 s,i,b n=U4
union u5 u4,u1 n=U5
uinter x1 n=X1
members x1 i
cls top a:u1,b:u2,c:u3,d:u4,e:u5,f:x1 n=Top
top Top top
finish
print
query groups 3,4,5,6,7
query groups 5,8
query recmembers 7 union
query canonical 5
